MEASURED on `php -n` 8.5.6 in CLI, with stdin piped and with stdin closed: both answer
`string(0) ""`. There is no request body in CLI and php does not go looking for one in stdin.
elephc answered `false`, which is what `file_get_contents()` says when the OPEN failed.

The distinction the caller boxes on is a NULL pointer, not a zero length — an empty file already
comes back as a real pointer of length zero — so the fix is to hand back a real pointer. The web
